name: dsu n=0
why: No operations and no vertices: states must be empty.

name: dsu repeated and self unions
why: (0,1):4 comps/max2; (2,3):3/2; repeat:3/2; self:3/2; (1,3) joins two pairs:2/4; self:2/4.

name: kruskal parallel negative loop isolate
why: Components {0,1,2},{3,4},{5}. Take -2 (parallel beats 5), 4, 7; self-loop -100 is never selected. n-c=3 edges, cost 9.

name: prim parallel negative loop isolate
why: Same graph as above; Prim must restart for {3,4} and for isolate 5.

name: kruskal tied cycle beyond 32 bits
why: 4-cycle, all weights 1e9: any 3 edges, 3e9 > 2^31-1. Other triples are accepted.

name: scc cycles, self-loop, duplicate cross edges
why: SCCs {0,1,2},{3,4},{5},{6}; cross edges 2->3, 0->3 (twice) collapse to one pair A->B.

name: topo duplicate edge and isolate
why: Constraints 3<1<0 and 4<0; vertex 2 is free. Other valid orders are accepted.

name: topo cycle in a later component
dag guard: do not relax from unreachable vertex
why: Vertex 0 is unreachable; edge 0->2 (-100) must be ignored. d(2)=-3 (parallel edges 1 or 2), d(3)=min(10,-3+7)=4.

name: dag cycle unreachable from source
why: Cycle 2<->3 is unreachable but the whole graph is checked.

name: dag unreachable distance is null not -1
why: Edge 0->1 points INTO the source; vertex 0 is unreachable.
